papers.title_en: Constant Individual Regret in General Games
papers.authors: Mingyang Liu, Gabriele Farina, Asuman Ozdaglar
papers.evidence: 完全解耦的无遗憾动力学为均衡提供去中心化路径，与去中心化多智能体强化学习直接相关
papers.tldr: 无耦合无遗憾动态是博弈论中分布式到达均衡的重要工具，但已有算法的个体遗憾对时间范围有多对数依赖。本文针对有限N人一般和博弈，在完全信息反馈下提出ECHO-OFTRL算法，通过结合指数移动平均级联的乐观FTRL实现高阶乐观。该算法对所有T同时保证每个玩家的遗憾上界为常数O(poly(N, log m_max))，且是确定性、完全未耦合的，首次消除了遗憾对T的依赖。
papers.abstract_en: Uncoupled no-regret dynamics provide a decentralized route to equilibrium, but prior guarantees for individual regret retain a polylogarithmic dependence on the horizon. We remove this dependence for every finite $N$-player normal-form game under full-information feedback. We introduce \emph{ECHO-OFTRL}: optimistic follow-the-regularized-leader (OFTRL) equipped with an EMA cascade for high-order optimism (ECHO), where EMA denotes exponential moving average. The algorithm is deterministic and fully uncoupled. If $m_{\max}$ denotes the largest action-set size, then, simultaneously for every horizon $T\geq1$, it guarantees that each of the $N$ players in the game incurs regret upper bounded by $O(\textrm{poly}(N, \log m_{\max}))$. Our algorithm leverages a new form of optimism inspired by modern filter design.

papers.title_en: Reinforcement Learning Enhanced LLM Agents for Complex Vehicle Routing Problems
papers.authors: Yi Chen, Zikang Yu, Jiahai Wang, Jinbiao Chen, Jianpeng Zhou, Zizhen Zhang
papers.evidence: 多智能体LLM框架结合强化学习规划的VRP应用
papers.tldr: 车辆路径问题（VRP）是典型的组合优化难题，但传统求解器建模复杂变体需要大量领域知识。本文提出多智能体框架RLEA，用Soft Q-learning训练的轻量级Planner调度LLM智能体，并引入进化记忆与检索增强生成，以结合经验和外部求解器知识。在48种VRP变体上，RLEA成功率比现有最优方法高16.67%，且显著减少运行时错误，验证了强化学习与LLM推理结合对自动化优化建模的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Vehicle Routing Problems (VRPs) are fundamental combinatorial optimization problems with widespread applications in various scenarios. The advanced optimization solvers can effectively solve such problems. However, modeling complex VRP variants for solvers often requires substantial domain expertise, which limits the accessibility of advanced optimization technologies. In this paper, we propose Reinforcement Learning Enhanced LLMAgents(RLEA), a multi-agent framework designed to automate the modeling of complex VRPs. RLEA introduces a lightweight neural Planner trained with Soft Q-learning to efficiently orchestrate the actions of LLM-based agents. In addition, we equip the system with an evolutionary memory module and retrieval-augmented generation, enabling the agent to leverage both accumulated experience and external solver knowledge during program generation and refinement for solving VRPs. We evaluated 48 distinct VRP variants across various solvers. The experimental results demonstrate that RLEA outperforms the previous state-of-the-ar method, achieving a 16.67% higher success rate while significantly reducing runtime errors. These results validate that integrating reinforcement learning with LLM-based reasoning is highly effective for automated optimization modeling. The appendix is available at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19134435.
